rust_summary: A bounded measurement of text in the native drawing font.
doc_summary: `text_width(text)` returns the width in GUI pixels using `native_text`'s literal component and font metrics, rounded up to a whole pixel. It returns None outside a native mod call, for text longer than 4096 bytes, or after 8192 calls per mod in a one-second window. At most 256 callers are tracked in a window. Requires native hooks API @API:text_width@.
